name: lemon8/app/discover-banners
description: Returns the current promotional and featured banners displayed on the Lemon8 discover page. Applications can use this data to inspect active platform campaigns and highlighted topics.

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.

readme:
# Lemon8 Discover Page Banners API

Call this endpoint without additional parameters to inspect the latest promotional banners featured on the Lemon8 discover page.

## Use cases

- Display current Lemon8 campaign banners inside external dashboards.
- Monitor featured marketing events showcased on the discover page.
- Track active promotional highlights across the Lemon8 platform.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/lemon8/app/discover-banners" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{}'
```

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.

## Related APIs

- [Lemon8 Discover Page Content](/apis/lemon8/app/discover-tab): Returns the main content featured on the Lemon8 discover tab.
- [Lemon8 Discover Editor Picks](/apis/lemon8/app/discover-tab-information-tabs): Returns the Editor's Picks and discover tab information from the Lemon8 mobile app.
- [Lemon8 Hot Search Keywords](/apis/lemon8/app/hot-search-keywords): Returns trending search keywords and topics currently popular on Lemon8.
